description: 0.0.7 example (specs/jos-format/0.0.7/examples/executable.jos) whose definitions are `type: prompt` steps. rc.8: invalid (code 2) in validate and run alike. A definition is a reference, an inline document or a 1.0.0 step `type: shell|jos|http` (SPEC-2.0 §5.1), and schema/jos.schema.json closes both the type and the members of a definition; the normalized 0.0.7 document keeps the definitions as written (§2.4), so it does not validate. rc.3 to rc.7 read it as valid and unexecutable (code 5, I71), against the schema.
